gizmo.title: Kusundidzira kuzvifungisisa
gizmo.description: Kumbira mudzidzi kuti afungisise giredhi kana manzwiro ake, wozopa kurudziro yekuzvigadzirisa zvichibva pamhinduro.

configure.title: Mhando yekupinza
configure.description: Nzira yaanoudza nayo mudzidzi kuti ari kuita sei. Dzose dzinoshandisa chiyero che0 kusvika ku4 (giredhi: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; manzwiro: pasi zvikuru=0 kusvika zvakanakisa=4).

configure.title: Mubvunzo
configure.description: Mubvunzo wemudzidzi. Siya uri pasina kuti ushandise zvakajairwa zvemhando yekupinza.

configure.title: Kurudziro
configure.description: Mhinduro inoratidzwa pamhando dzakasiyana dzemhinduro. Inoshandiswa renji yekutanga inoenderana.
